title: kbid.usual_pair breaks a tie alphabetically although its docstring says the first pair in text order
goal: kbid.usual_pair and its docstring agree on the pair it suggests on a tie: the first pair in the root's text order, as the docstring says, so the check: guess kbid.py add prints for a host whose pairs tie is the one the file lists first.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbid; p=kbid.usual_pair([{'url':'https://h.example.com/a','licence':'Z','reuse':'quote'},{'url':'https://h.example.com/b','licence':'A','reuse':'copy'}],'https://h.example.com/c'); sys.exit(0 if p[0]==('Z','quote') else 1)
